title.zh: A $7 billion crypto ETF plumbing boom just ran into the IRS
title.en: A $7 billion crypto ETF plumbing boom just ran into the IRS

current_state.zh: The Treasury Department and IRS have flagged digital-asset ETF structures in a tax review, warning that fund sponsors may be stretching RIC qualification rules to keep crypto gains untaxed, potentially forcing changes to how such funds are packaged and redeemed.
